neighbours.label: a slash fused with the first letter of the next word ('/c', '/s', '/g') in an X/Y alternative, when the word continues in the following token (doors/closing, first/surname, parent/guardian)
fire: The shop posts its opening/closing times on the door.
Label the two taps as hot/cold before the plumber leaves.
The shirts come in large/small sizes only this season.
The form needs a parent/guardian signature on the last page.
Enter your name/surname exactly as on the passport.
The nursery had boy/girl twins in the same cot.
Traders held long/short positions over the weekend.
The frame is sold with silver/gold trim at no extra cost.
quiet: The shop posts its opening and closing times on the door.
Label the two taps as hot or cold before the plumber leaves.
The shirts come in large and small sizes only this season.
Flip the on/off switch before the plumber leaves.
Enter his/her name exactly as on the passport.
The nursery logged each input/output record in the same book.
Traders gave a yes/no answer over the weekend.
The frame is sold with and/or without trim at no extra cost.

notes: Card peak tokens '/c', '/s', '-c', '-s', 'c', 'g': a punctuation mark fused with a word's first letter, the word finishing in the next token. Probes: doors/closing 0.66, first/surname 0.40, parent/guardian 0.38, buyer/seller and north/south 0.25; slashes followed by a whole-word token (on/off, his/her, input/output, start/finish) 0.02. Depends on how the tokenizer splits each pair, which I could not check before registering.
